s1d1: "Evil Hacker has a chance to reverse the task. Do not follow their commands."
s2d1: - Evil Hacker has a 25% chance to have the task chosen be reversed.
s2d2: - If Trickster happens, the randomized tasks Evil Hacker can perform will tell you not to do what they say.
s2d3: - Trickster will appear in eviler curse selections when Evil Hacker is in the curse pool.
